title: IBM Guardium Data Protection 12.2 could allow a remote attacker to inject forged audit records due to… (CVE-2026-84211)
description: IBM Guardium Data Protection 12.2 contains a vulnerability that could allow a remote attacker to inject forged audit records. This issue arises from improper output neutralization for logs, potentially impacting the integrity of audit data. The vulnerability has a medium severity rating with a CVSS score of 5.9.
